name: ernd card
description: The credit card for the AI stack, for US companies.

rates.label: 4% back on AI vendor spend
rates.applies_to: Card spend at AI vendors such as OpenAI and Anthropic

card.cost: Requesting a card is free, and there's no annual fee.
card.redemption: Points are redeemable as cash back, and go further on travel ernd books and with recommended providers.
card.terms: Final terms come with the card.

availability.how: A company admin sends the request for the company.

not_partners.statement: OpenAI and Anthropic are not ernd partners or sponsors and don't endorse ernd. Cardholders pay them with the card like any other business card.

partners.order: The order of the perk wall on ernd.ai: featured partners first, then the rest.
partners.disclosure: sponsored: true means the partner pays ernd for its listing. Featured partners appear first on ernd.ai, in the order ernd chose; Hopper, Agent 37 and Trace pay for their listing, and Wafer does not. Every other partner is listed for its perk alone.

items.name: Wafer
items.note: Serverless and dedicated inference for open models

items.name: Trace
items.note: AI pen tests: the Startup plan for $1,500, normally $4,000

items.name: Hopper
items.note: On API credits, plus a free first month

items.name: Firecrawl
items.note: Earns the standard 1.5% back. Firecrawl's extra is higher limits, not a higher rate.
